blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have introduced a generative approach to recommendation, producing item lists from textual representations of user histories and item information. However, this generative setting raises challenges concerning output validity, prompt consistency, and sensitivity to demographic descriptors. In this work, we investigate how preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data affect recommendation utility and fairness-related behavior in a generative LLM-based recommender system. We first establish a controlled recommendation pipeline that combines supervised fine-tuning, catalog-constrained decoding, and prompt augmentation. We then study three preprocessing choices: item-title representation, demographic balancing, and auxiliary item-knowledge enrichment. Experiments on MovieLens-1M show that the catalog-constrained pipeline eliminates out-of-catalog items and ensures complete ten-item outputs, while prompt augmentation improves prompt consistency and utility. Original MovieLens titles increase HR@10 from 10.67% to 12.47% and Coverage@10 from 41.36% to 47.88%. Fairness-related effects are attribute-dependent: age balancing and knowledge enrichment reduce selected group-level utility gaps while largely preserving utility, whereas gender balancing reduces utility without improving the evaluated gender-related indicators. Overall, preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data should be evaluated jointly in terms of utility, output behavior, and demographic sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)引入了一种对推荐的基因化方法,从用户历史和项目信息的文字表述中生成项目清单. 然而,这种基因设定在产出有效性、迅速一致性和对人口描述的敏感性方面提出了挑战。 在这项工作中,我们调查微调数据中的预处理选择如何影响一个基因LLM-基于推荐者的系统中的推荐效用和与公平相关的行为. 我们首先建立了一个控制性建议管道,将监督的微调、编目约束的解码和迅速增强结合起来。 然后,我们研究三个预处理选择:项目标题说明、人口平衡和辅助项目知识丰富。 关于电影Lens-1的实验 M显示,受目录限制的管线消除了目录外的项目,并确保完成十项产出,而即时增强则能提高及时的一致性和效用. 电影原版标题将HR@10从10.67%增加到12.47%,覆盖度从41.36%增加到47.88%。 公平性相关效应取决于属性:年龄平衡和知识的丰富缩小了某些群体层面的效用差距,同时在很大程度上保持效用,而性别均衡则减少效用,而不改进经评价的与性别有关的指标。 总体而言,在微调数据方面的预处理选择应当从效用、产出行为和人口敏感性等方面联合评价。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used in recommender systems, enabling recommendations through natural language prompts ( Liang et al., 2025 ) , conversational interaction ( Li et al., 2025a ) , textual item representations ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and domain-specific fine-tuning ( Hou et al., 2026 ) .
Their understanding of natural language allows user histories, preferences, and candidate items to be represented in a single format. However, text-based recommendation introduces risks that are less apparent in conventional recommender systems ( Munson et al., 2025 ) , including malformed outputs, repeated or out-of-catalog items ( Liao et al., 2026 ) , and prompt sensitivity ( Li et al., 2025b ) . These challenges highlight the importance of understanding not only the quality of LLM-generated recommendations, but also the factors that shape their outputs.
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地用于推荐者系统,通过自然语言提示(Liang等人,2025年),对话互动(Li等人,2025年a年),文字项目表述(Wang等人,2025年),以及域名特定的微调(Hou等人,2026年),实现建议.
他们对自然语言的理解使得用户历史,偏好,以及候选项目能够以单一格式得到体现. 然而,基于文字的建议引入了在常规推荐人系统中不太明显的风险(Munson等人,2025年),包括产出不整齐,重复或目录之外的物品(廖等人,2026年),以及即时敏感性(李等人,2025年b). 这些挑战突出表明,不仅要了解LLM产生的建议的质量,而且要了解影响其产出的因素。

blocks.en:
Unlike conventional recommender systems that typically learn user and item representations from interaction data, LLM-based recommender systems can formulate recommendation tasks through natural language and textual representations of user interactions, item information, and recommendation instructions.
In this setting, the way user preferences, interaction histories, and item information are expressed in the model input can directly influence the generated recommendations. This makes both the design of training data and the formulation of inference-time prompts important design choices.
In generative LLM-based recommendation settings, the model generates a sequence of recommended items conditioned on a prompt that represents the user’s interaction history and may also include demographic attributes, which are commonly treated as sensitive attributes in fairness research. This raises an important concern about whether LLM-based recommender systems can be sensitive to demographic information embedded in the model input. Although end users may not explicitly state demographic attributes in a recommendation request, such attributes may still be available to a recommender through user profiles or other contextual information. We therefore introduce demographic descriptors explicitly as a controlled intervention, allowing us to examine whether recommendation outputs change when demographic information is varied while the interaction history is held fixed.
blocks.zh:
与通常从互动数据中学习用户和项目表达的常规推荐者系统不同,基于LLM的推荐者系统可以通过用户互动的自然语言和文字表达,项目信息,以及建议指令来制定推荐任务.
在这种环境下,在模型输入中表达用户偏好,互动历史和项目信息的方式可以直接影响生成的建议. 这使得培训数据的设计以及推断时间的制定都促使人们作出重要的设计选择。
在基于基因的LLM推荐设置中,模型生成一系列以代表用户互动历史的提示为条件的推荐项目,也可能包括人口属性,在公平研究中通常将其作为敏感属性处理. 这引起了对基于LLM的推荐系统能否对模型输入中嵌入的人口信息敏感的重要关注. 虽然终端用户在推荐请求中可能没有明确说明人口属性,但通过用户简介或其他背景信息,推荐者仍可获取此类属性. 因此,我们明确将人口描述作为控制下的干预措施,使我们能够审查当人口信息各不相同而互动历史保持不变时,建议的产出是否发生变化。

blocks.en: Recent studies show that sensitive attributes can influence LLM recommendation outcomes, suggesting that fairness assessment in this setting requires more than standard accuracy metrics ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Sah et al., 2025 ) . Evaluation should therefore consider not only whether a model recovers held-out preferences, but also whether its outputs remain stable across demographic conditions and whether utility differs among user groups. At the same time, demographic sensitivity by itself does not necessarily constitute evidence of discrimination. We therefore interpret differences in recommendation outcomes across demographic conditions as fairness-related signals rather than direct evidence of discrimination ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Vassøy and Langseth, 2024 ) . Such comparisons, however, require recommendation outputs that are sufficiently structured and consistent across conditions. LLM recommenders do not always provide this level of output control ( Munson et al., 2025 ) . In particular, variations in output length or format can make it difficult to determine whether changes in recommendation lists are caused by preprocessing choices or by the generation process itself. This makes output control an important prerequisite for evaluating how preprocessing choices affect recommendation behavior.
blocks.zh: 近期的研究表明,敏感属性可以影响LLM推荐结果,表明在此背景下的公平性评估需要的不仅仅是标准精确度度量(Zhang等人,2023年;Sah等人,2025年). 因此,评价不仅应考虑一个模式是否恢复了被搁置的偏好,而且还应考虑其产出在人口状况中是否保持稳定,用户群体之间的效用是否不同。 同时,人口敏感性本身不一定构成歧视的证据。 因此,我们将不同人口状况的建议结果的差异解释为与公平有关的信号,而不是歧视的直接证据(Wu等人,2023年;Vassøy和Langseth,2024年)。 然而,这种比较要求建议产出结构充分,并符合不同情况。 LLM推荐人并不总是提供这种水平的输出控制(Munson等人,2025年). 特别是,产出长度或格式的变化可能难以确定对建议清单的修改是由预处理选择还是由生成过程本身造成的。 这使得输出控制成为评价预处理选择如何影响建议行为的重要前提.

blocks.en:
This raises an important question of whether demographic sensitivity can be influenced before recommendation generation and, if so, which aspects of the recommendation pipeline affect it. Recent studies on LLM-based recommender systems have explored several adaptation strategies, including prompt-based recommendation, instruction tuning, hybrid textual and behavioral representations, data augmentation, and the use of external item knowledge ( Bao et al., 2023 ; Liao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) . Together, these studies suggest that recommendation behavior can be shaped by choices made at different stages of the LLM recommendation pipeline.
In parallel, fairness-oriented work has examined whether LLM recommenders produce different outcomes across sensitive user attributes and how such behavior can be mitigated through prompt- or inference-level interventions ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Hua et al., 2024 ; Fayyazi et al., 2025 ) .
Despite these advances, comparatively less attention has been paid to the construction of fine-tuning data itself as a design factor and to how such choices may jointly affect recommendation utility and fairness-related behavior.
In this work, we investigate three preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data, focusing on how item titles are represented, how demographic groups are distributed across the fine-tuning data, and whether additional item information is incorporated through auxiliary fine-tuning examples. We study these factors in the context of catalog-constrained LLM recommendation, without assuming that preprocessing alone resolves fairness concerns.
blocks.zh:
这提出了一个重要的问题,即在提出建议之前,人口敏感性能否受到影响,如果是的话,建议拟订过程的哪些方面影响到它。 最近关于基于LLM的推荐人系统的研究探索了若干适应战略,包括即时推荐,指令调试,混合文字和行为表现,数据增强,以及外部项目知识的使用(Bao等人,2023年;Liao等人,2024年;Wang等人,2024年;Lin等人,2025年). 这些研究共同表明,建议行为可以通过在LLM建议管道的不同阶段作出的选择来形成。
与此同时,面向公平的工作还审查了LLM推荐者是否在敏感的用户属性中产生不同的结果,以及如何通过迅速或推论层面的干预来减轻这种行为(Zhang等人,2023年;Hua等人,2024年;Fayyazi等人,2025年)。
尽管取得了这些进展,但相对较少注意将数据本身作为设计因素进行微调,以及这类选择如何共同影响建议效用和与公平有关的行为。
在这项工作中,我们调查了在微调数据方面的三个预处理选择,重点是项目标题的表述方式,人口组别如何在微调数据中分布,以及是否通过辅助微调实例纳入额外项目信息. 我们研究这些因素的背景是目录限制的LLM建议,而并不假定单靠预处理就能解决公平问题。

blocks.en:
This study examines preprocessing in fine-tuning data as a design factor that can affect recommendation utility, output control, and demographic sensitivity together.
We address four research questions. We first establish whether the generative recommendation pipeline provides a sufficiently controlled basis for comparison (RQ1), and then examine three preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data concerning item representation, demographic balancing, and auxiliary item knowledge (RQ2–RQ4). • RQ1: Does the recommendation pipeline provide sufficient catalog validity, output control, and prompt consistency for controlled comparisons of preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data? • RQ2: How does item-title representation affect recommendation utility and catalog usage within the catalog-constrained recommendation pipeline? • RQ3: How does demographic balancing in fine-tuning data affect recommendation utility and sensitivity to demographic descriptors? • RQ4: Can knowledge-enriched fine-tuning data reduce demographic sensitivity while preserving recommendation utility? We investigate these questions by fine-tuning multiple LLM-based recommender variants within a shared catalog-constrained decoding framework.
The variants differ only in three preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data: item-title representation, demographic balancing of recommendation examples, and auxiliary item-knowledge enrichment. We evaluate all variants under a shared protocol that combines utility with behavioral and fairness-oriented diagnostics. We measure whether generated lists recover held-out user preferences, remain valid and diverse within the target catalog, and change when demographic descriptors are added to the prompt.
Evaluating these dimensions together reveals trade-offs that accuracy alone would miss, particularly when models achieve similar recommendation quality but exhibit different levels of demographic sensitivity.
blocks.zh:
本研究将微调数据的预处理作为设计因素,可共同影响建议效用、产出控制和人口敏感性。
我们处理四个研究问题。 我们首先确定基因建议程序是否为比较提供了充分控制的基础(RQ1),然后审查在细化关于项目表述、人口平衡和辅助项目知识的数据方面的三个预处理选择(RQ2-RQ4)。 • RQ1:建议程序是否提供了足够的目录有效性、产出控制以及快速一致性,以便对微调数据中的预处理选择进行有控制的比较? • RQ2:项目标题表述如何影响建议效用和目录内受目录限制的建议编审中的使用? • 支助 RQ3:在微调数据方面的人口平衡如何影响建议效用和对人口描述的敏感性? • 支助 RQ4:知识丰富的微调数据能否在保持建议效用的同时降低人口敏感性? 我们通过在共享目录约束解码框架内微调多个基于LLM的推荐器变体来调查这些问题.
变式仅在细化数据的三个预处理选择上有所不同:项目标题表述、建议实例的人口平衡和辅助项目知识丰富。 我们通过一个共同的协议来评估所有变体,该协议将实用性与行为和以公平为导向的诊断相结合。 我们衡量生成的列表是否恢复了被搁置的用户偏好,在目标目录中是否仍然有效和多样,以及当人口描述符添加到提示符中时是否发生变化。
对这些层面进行共同评估,可以发现,仅靠准确性就会失去利弊,特别是当模型具有类似的建议质量但显示出不同的人口敏感性时。

blocks.en: RQ1: Does the recommendation pipeline provide sufficient catalog validity, output control, and prompt consistency for controlled comparisons of preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data?
blocks.zh: RQ1:建议管道是否提供了足够的目录有效性,输出控制,以及快速的一致性,用于在微调数据中对预处理选择进行控制比较?

blocks.en: RQ2: How does item-title representation affect recommendation utility and catalog usage within the catalog-constrained recommendation pipeline?
blocks.zh: RQ2:项目标题表述如何影响建议效用和目录在目录约束性建议编目中的使用?

blocks.en: RQ3: How does demographic balancing in fine-tuning data affect recommendation utility and sensitivity to demographic descriptors?
blocks.zh: RQ3:在微调数据方面的人口平衡如何影响建议效用和对人口描述的敏感性?

blocks.en: RQ4: Can knowledge-enriched fine-tuning data reduce demographic sensitivity while preserving recommendation utility?
blocks.zh: RQ4:知识丰富的微调数据能否在保持建议效用的同时降低人口敏感性?

blocks.en: Our findings demonstrate that preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data have heterogeneous effects on both utility and demographic sensitivity. Item-title representation substantially affects recommendation utility and catalog usage, while demographic balancing produces attribute-dependent outcomes: age balancing improves some fairness-related indicators while largely preserving recommendation utility, whereas gender balancing does not provide the same benefit. Auxiliary item-knowledge enrichment reduces the gender-related SNSR and narrows the neutral group-level utility gap for both attributes, although its effect on the remaining indicators is attribute-dependent. These interventions do not eliminate fairness concerns, but they provide empirical evidence that preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data can influence the trade-off between recommendation utility and fairness-related behavior.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究结果表明,在微调数据方面的预处理选择对效用和人口敏感性都有不同的影响。 项目标题表述对建议效用和目录使用有重大影响,而人口平衡则产生依赖属性的结果:年龄平衡可以改善一些与公平有关的指标,同时在很大程度上保持建议的效用,而性别平衡不能提供同样的好处。 辅助项目知识的丰富减少了与性别有关的SNSR,并缩小了两个属性的中性群体层次的效用差距,尽管它对其余指标的影响取决于属性。 这些干预措施并没有消除对公平性的关切,但它们提供了经验性证据,表明在微调数据方面的预处理选择可以影响建议效用与公平相关行为之间的权衡.

blocks.en: The contributions of this work are as follows: • We establish a controlled catalog-constrained LLM recommendation framework with prompt augmentation that provides a consistent experimental backbone for comparing preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data. • We study three preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data: how items are presented, how demographic groups are distributed in the fine-tuning data, and whether additional item information is introduced through auxiliary fine-tuning examples. We analyze their effects on recommendation utility, group-level utility differences, and sensitivity to demographic descriptors, without introducing an explicit fairness-specific training objective. • We employ a unified evaluation protocol for catalog-constrained LLM recommendation that jointly considers recommendation utility, output-control behavior, group-level utility differences, and demographic prompt sensitivity. • We provide empirical evidence that preprocessing in fine-tuning data is not merely a technical preparation step, but a consequential design choice that can affect both recommendation performance and fairness-related behavior in LLM-based recommender systems.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的贡献如下: 我们建立了一个控制下目录限制的LLM建议框架,并附有即时增强功能,为在微调数据中比较预处理选择提供一致的实验骨干。 我们在微调数据方面研究了三个预处理选择:项目是如何呈现的,人口组别是如何在微调数据中分布的,以及是否通过辅助微调实例引入额外项目信息. 我们分析它们对建议效用、集团一级效用差异以及对人口说明的敏感性的影响,但没有提出明确的公平培训目标。 我们采用统一的评价协议,对目录限制的LLM建议进行统一评价,共同考虑建议效用、产出控制行为、组级效用差异和人口迅速敏感性。 我们提供了经验证据,证明微调数据的预处理不仅仅是一个技术准备步骤,而且是一个相应的设计选择,既会影响基于LLM的推荐人系统中的推荐性能,也会影响与公平相关的行为.

blocks.en: 2. Literature Review
blocks.zh: 2. 文学评论

blocks.en:
Generative Recommendation and Catalog Grounding. Many LLM-based recommender systems represent users, items, collaborative interaction histories, and recommendation targets as textual sequences.
Among the foundational approaches, P5 proposed a unified text-to-text framework for multiple recommendation tasks, followed by systems such as OpenP5 for developing and evaluating generative recommenders and GPTRec for autoregressive sequential recommendation, and GenRec, which formulates sequential recommendation as a sequence-to-sequence generation task ( Geng et al., 2022 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Petrov and Macdonald, 2023 ; Cao and Lio, 2024 ) . Subsequent work has further explored instruction tuning, collaborative signals, data augmentation, and external knowledge to adapt LLMs to recommendation ( Bao et al., 2023 ; Liao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
基因建议和目录定位。 许多基于LLM的推荐器系统代表用户,项目,协作互动历史,以及推荐目标作为文本序列.
在基础方法中,五常提出了多个建议任务的统一的文本对文本框架,然后是开发和评价基因推荐人的OpenP5和自动顺序推荐的GPTRec等系统,以及作为顺序对序列生成任务的GenRec(Geng等人,2022年;Xu等人,2024年;Petrov和Macdonald,2023年;Cao和Lio,2024年)。 随后的工作进一步探索了指令调试,协作信号,数据增强,以及外部知识,以适应建议(Bao等人,2023年;Liao等人,2024年;Wang等人,2024年;徐等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Nevertheless, compared with conventional fixed-candidate ranking, generative recommender systems face challenges such as malformed, repeated, or out-of-catalog items ( Munson et al., 2025 ) . Catalog-grounding methods address these issues through retrieval, constrained generation, or item tokenization ( Liao et al., 2026 ) . Within such frameworks, item representation is an important design choice, as alternative representation strategies can influence the way items are encoded and generated by the model ( Xu et al., 2024 ) . Catalog constraints therefore provide a controlled output space for comparing alternative representation choices, although they do not themselves guarantee relevance, diversity, or fairness.
blocks.zh: 然而,与常规的固定候选人排名相比,基因推荐者系统面临诸如畸形、重复或目录外项目等挑战(Munson等人,2025年)。 编目测底方法通过检索、限制生成或标注物品来解决这些问题(廖等人,2026年)。 在这些框架内,项目表述是一项重要的设计选择,因为替代性表述战略可以影响模型对项目编码和生成的方式(徐等人,2024年)。 因此,目录限制为比较替代性代表选择提供了可控产出空间,尽管这些限制本身并不能保证相关性、多样性或公正性。

blocks.en:
Prompt Sensitivity and Fairness. LLM-based recommendations can be sensitive to variations in prompts and generation, leading to inconsistent outputs for similar recommendation contexts. Recent studies
show that variations in prompt formulation and repeated generation can affect recommendation outcomes ( Li et al., 2025b ; Kweon et al., 2025 ) .
This variability is relevant to fairness evaluation, because recommendation changes associated with demographic information should be distinguished from general prompt sensitivity and output differences.

表明迅速配制和重复生成的变异可能影响建议结果(Li等人,2025年b;Kweon等人,2025年b)。
这种可变性与公平评价有关,因为与人口信息有关的建议变化应与一般的即时敏感性和产出差异区别开来。

blocks.en: Fairness in recommendation concerns whether recommendation outcomes differ systematically across users or groups, particularly with respect to demographic attributes ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Vassøy and Langseth, 2024 ) . In LLM-based recommendation, recent studies have examined whether sensitive user attributes influence generated recommendations and have proposed fairness-aware prompting and mitigation strategies ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Sah et al., 2025 ; Hua et al., 2024 ; Fayyazi et al., 2025 ; Andre et al., 2025 ) . Thus, differences in recommendation outcomes across demographic conditions should be interpreted under controlled prompt conditions and together with recommendation utility, rather than as direct evidence of unfairness.
blocks.zh: 建议的公平性涉及建议结果是否在用户或群体之间有系统差异,特别是在人口特征方面(Wu等人,2023年;Vassøy和Langseth,2024年)。 在基于LLM的建议中,最近的研究审查了敏感的用户属性影响是否产生建议,并提出了公平意识促进和缓解战略(Zhang等人,2023年;Sah等人,2025年;Hua等人,2024年;Fayyazi等人,2025年;Andre等人,2025年)。 因此,不同人口状况中建议结果的差异应当在控制下的迅速条件下与建议效用一起解释,而不是作为不公平的直接证据。

blocks.en: Preprocessing Choices in Fine-Tuning Data. Data-level interventions have been explored in conventional recommender systems as a means of improving fairness. Chen et al. employ data augmentation to rebalance the training distribution, while Melchiorre et al. investigate resampling as a preprocessing strategy for mitigating gender-related disparities in recommendation outcomes ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Melchiorre et al., 2021 ) . These studies demonstrate that the composition of training data can itself serve as an intervention point for fairness.
blocks.zh: 精细调试数据中的预处理选择 。 在传统推荐人系统中探讨了数据层面的干预措施,作为提高公平性的一种手段。 陈等. 利用数据扩充来重新平衡培训的分布,而Melchiorre等人则将重新取样作为一种预先处理战略,以减少建议结果中的性别差异(Chen等人,2023年;Melchiorre等人,2021年)。 这些研究表明,培训数据的组成本身可以作为公平性的干预点。

blocks.en:
In LLM-based recommendation, prior work has examined aspects of fine-tuning data and task construction primarily from the perspectives of recommendation performance and efficiency.
Lin et al. investigate representative sample selection for fine-tuning ( Lin et al., 2024 ) , while Liu et al. propose a user-level supervised fine-tuning (SFT) formulation for injecting collaborative information into an LLM-based sequential recommendation framework ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . However, comparatively less attention has been paid to how preprocessing choices in LLM fine-tuning data affect both recommendation utility and sensitivity to demographic information.
blocks.zh:
在基于LLM的建议中,先前的工作主要从建议业绩和效率的角度审查了数据微调和任务构建的各个方面。
Lin等人调查代表性选样进行微调(Lin等人,2024年),刘等人则调查. 提出用户一级监督微调(SFT)的配方,将协作信息注入基于LLM的顺序建议框架(Liu等人,2024年)。 然而,对LLM微调数据中的预处理选择如何影响建议效用和对人口信息敏感程度的关注相对较少。

blocks.en: To address this gap, this study examines three preprocessing choices in the fine-tuning data, namely item title representation, demographic balancing, and auxiliary item-knowledge enrichment, within a shared catalog-constrained framework.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,本研究研究了微调数据中的三个预处理选择,即项目标题表述、人口平衡和辅助项目知识丰富,在一个共同的目录限制框架内进行。

We first establish a shared catalog-constrained recommendation backbone and then study three preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data: item-title representation, demographic balancing, and auxiliary item-knowledge enrichment. We then evaluate recommendation utility, output behavior, prompt consistency, and demographic sensitivity.

blocks.en: The decoder does not explicitly enforce exactly K K completed item spans, prevent early sequence termination, or mask previously generated items. Therefore, Exact- K K compliance and repetition are treated as empirical output-control measures rather than guaranteed properties of constrained decoding.
blocks.zh: 解码器没有明确执行精确的 K K 完成的项目跨度,防止早期序列终止,或者遮盖先前生成的项目. 因此,精确的KK遵守和重复被视为经验性的产出控制措施,而不是受限制的解码的保证性质。

blocks.en: 3.4. Prompt Augmentation
blocks.zh: 3.4. 迅速扩充

blocks.en: Language model behavior can change across instruction paraphrases, prompt templates, and small textual perturbations, even when the task itself is unchanged ( Mizrahi et al., 2024 ; Chatterjee et al., 2024 ) . A model fine-tuned on a single instruction wording may therefore become dependent on that particular presentation. To reduce this dependence, for prompt-augmented configurations, we expose the model during fine-tuning to multiple prompt formulations of the recommendation instruction. The goal is to encourage robustness to changes in prompt wording and presentation format while preserving the underlying recommendation task.
blocks.zh: 语言模型行为可以跨指令解说,即时模板,以及小的文字扰动,即使任务本身没有变化(Mizrahi等人,2024年;Chatterjee等人,2024年). 因此,对单一指示措词进行微调的模式可能取决于该特定表述。 为了减少这种依赖性,对于快速增强的配置,我们在微调时将模型暴露在推荐指令的多个快速配方中. 目标是鼓励在保留基本建议任务的同时,迅速改变措辞和列报格式。

blocks.en: Prompt Perturbation Consistency Learning (PPCL) addresses prompt sensitivity by introducing a consistency objective between clean and perturbed prompts ( Qiang et al., 2024 ) . Inspired by this idea, we use template-based prompt augmentation, but incorporate the augmented prompts directly into fine-tuning without an additional consistency objective.
blocks.zh: 快速扰动一致性学习(PPCL)通过在清洁和扰动的提示之间引入一个一致性目标来解决快速敏感性问题(Qiang等人,2024年)。 受这一想法的启发,我们使用基于模板的即时增强,但将增强的提示直接纳入微调中,而没有额外的一致性目标.

blocks.en:
Formally, we extend the prompt function introduced in the task formulation from a single function ϕ \phi to a collection of prompt templates Φ = { ϕ 1 , ϕ 2 , … , ϕ M } \Phi=\{\phi_{1},\phi_{2},\ldots,\phi_{M}\} .
For a fixed user history H u H_{u} and descriptor d d , template ϕ m ∈ Φ \phi_{m}\in\Phi constructs the input x u ( m ) = ϕ m ​ ( H u , d ) . x_{u}^{(m)}=\phi_{m}(H_{u};d). During prompt-augmented fine-tuning, we set d = ∅ d=\varnothing .
The templates vary the instruction wording, constraint emphasis, preference framing, prompt format and length, and minor text perturbations, while preserving the underlying interaction history, serialized target sequence, item representation, and recommendation objective.

In addition to prompt instruction variation, we also vary how the interaction history H u H_{u} is presented in the prompt without changing its item content or ordering.
During construction of a supervised recommendation example, a prompt template and one of the supported history formats are selected to form the input. For a fixed example and item-representation configuration ρ \rho , the target sequence y u y_{u} , catalog ℐ \mathcal{I} , serialization function s ρ s_{\rho} , and output contract remain unchanged. Thus, prompt augmentation changes only how the input is expressed, while preserving the recommendation task and its target space.
blocks.zh:
除了即时指令变异之外,我们还在不改变其项目内容或顺序的情况下,在即时显示交互历史H u H_{u}的方式也有所不同.
在构建一个受监督的建议示例时,会选择一个快速模板和一个支持的历史格式来形成输入. 对于一个固定的示例和项目表示配置 $\rho,目标序列 y y\ u\u},目录 I\ mathcal{I},序列化函数 s ^ s\\rho},输出合同保持不变. 因此,即时增强只改变投入的表达方式,同时保留建议任务及其目标空间。

blocks.en: In contrast to training-time prompt augmentation, attribute-conditioned prompting is used during evaluation to measure sensitivity to demographic descriptors while keeping the underlying recommendation context fixed.
blocks.zh: 与培训时间的迅速增加形成对照的是,在评价期间采用带有属性条件的提示来衡量对人口描述的敏感性,同时固定建议的基本背景。

blocks.en: 4. Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4. 实验设置

blocks.en: This section describes the dataset, chronological split, and preparation of fine-tuning data, followed by the implementation details and evaluation metrics used across the experiments.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍数据集、时间顺序划分和编制微调数据的情况,然后介绍整个试验中使用的实施细节和评价衡量尺度。

blocks.en: 4.1. Dataset, Chronological Split, and Fine-Tuning Data Preparation
blocks.zh: 4.1. 数据集、时间顺序划分和精细调试数据准备

blocks.en: We conduct our experiments on MovieLens-1M, which contains 6,040 users, 3,883 movies, and 1,000,209 ratings ( Harper and Konstan, 2015 ) . Ratings greater than or equal to 4 are treated as positive interactions. Users with fewer than 22 positive interactions are excluded, ensuring sufficient interactions for the maximum-length training instance of ten history items and ten targets while reserving one interaction each for validation and testing. These criteria retain 4,995 users. For each user, positive interactions are ordered chronologically; the final interaction is separated as the test target, the preceding interaction is used for validation, and the remaining earlier interactions are used for the training set. This split yields one validation target and one test target for each of the 4,995 retained users. The recommendation fine-tuning records are then sampled from the remaining training interactions, as described below. The full catalog of 3,883 movies is retained for constrained generation; 3,432 items (88.4%) occur in the training interactions, while 451 items (11.6%) remain unseen in the recommendation fine-tuning data.
blocks.zh: 包括6,040名用户、3,883部电影、1000,209个收视率(Harper和Konstan,2015年)。 大于或等于4的评级被视为正相互作用。 排除了少于22个正相互作用的用户,确保了10个历史项目和10个目标的最大长培训实例的充分互动,同时保留了各1个互动用于验证和测试。 这些标准保留了4 995个用户。 对每个用户来说,正交互按时间顺序排列;最后交互作为测试目标分开,前一次交互用于验证,其余较早的交互用于训练集. 这种分割制为4 995个保留用户中的每个用户产生一个验证目标和一个测试目标. 然后从其余培训互动中抽取建议微调记录,详情如下。 保留了3 883部电影的完整目录,用于有限的生成;3 432部电影(88.4%)出现在培训互动中,而451部电影(11.6%)在建议微调数据中仍然未见。

blocks.en: Recommendation fine-tuning examples are constructed as history-to-target generation instances. For each user, we sample 20 training instances from the chronological training sequence, yielding 99,900 recommendation examples in total. Each instance contains a variable-length history and an ordered target list, with both lengths capped at ten items. The requested target count K K is written into the instruction, so the prompt and the target sequence always agree on list length. Extremely long raw titles are filtered using a 99th-percentile title-length cutoff to avoid formatting outliers. Histories are serialized using comma-separated, arrow-separated, semicolon-separated, and numbered-list formats while preserving chronological item order.
blocks.zh: 建议的微调实例是历史与目标生成实例。 对每个用户,我们从按时间顺序进行的培训中抽取了20个培训实例,总共产生了99 900个建议实例。 每个实例都包含一个可变长的历史和一个命令的目标列表,两个长度都封顶在十个项目上. 所请求的目标计数KK被写入指令,所以即时和目标序列总是同意列表长度. 极长的原始标题使用99百分位标题长度截断进行过滤,以避免格式化的输出器. 历史用逗号分隔,箭头分隔,分号分隔,编号列表格式进行序列化,同时保留时间顺序项目顺序.

blocks.en: We evaluate two item-title representations. The normalized-title condition moves trailing articles to the beginning of the title, e.g., Matrix, The (1999) becomes The Matrix (1999) . The original-title condition preserves the MovieLens surface form, e.g., Matrix, The (1999) . This distinction affects the token-level structure of the catalog: normalization rewrites 714 of the 3,883 titles, and the resulting catalog places 715 titles, or 18.4% of the catalog, behind one shared opening token. Under the original MovieLens form, no opening token accounts for more than 1.8% of the catalog. Both representations are applied consistently to training targets, parsing, and prefix-tree constrained decoding.
blocks.zh: 我们评价两个项目标题的说明。 正常的标题条件将随文章移动到标题的开头,例如Matrix, The (1999)成为了Matrix (1999). 原标题条件保留了MovieLens表面形式,例如Matrix, The (1999). 这种区分影响了目录的符号级结构:正常化重写了3,883个标题中的714个,由此形成的目录将715个标题,即目录的18.4%,放在一个共享的打开符号后面. 在原电影Lens格式下,没有开封符占目录的1.8%以上. 这两种表述都一致适用于培训目标、解析和前缀限制的树皮解码。

blocks.en: Following the RecLM-cgen design, which augments recommendation fine-tuning with conversational data to help preserve general conversational ability ( Liao et al., 2026 ) , we construct a mixed fine-tuning corpus containing 119,056 examples: 99,900 recommendation examples (83.9%), 14,161 general conversational examples (11.9%), and 4,995 recommendation-oriented conversational examples (4.2%). These proportions are design choices guided by prior mixed fine-tuning practice rather than fixed values copied from prior work.
blocks.zh: RECLM-cgen设计增加了建议用对话数据进行微调,以帮助维护一般对话能力(廖等人,2026年),在此之后,我们构建了包含119 056个实例的混合微调程序:99 900个建议实例(83.9%)、14 161个一般对话实例(11.9%)和4 995个面向建议的对话实例(4.2%)。 这些比例是在先前混合微调做法指导下的设计选择,而不是从先前的工作复制的固定值。

blocks.en: To reduce dependence on a single prompt wording, recommendation examples are expressed using 37 semantically equivalent instruction templates organized into six families as given in Table 1 . The templates differ in phrasing rather than task semantics, spanning direct recommendation, explicit rule lists, preference framing, output-format emphasis, compressed phrasing, and minor misspellings. The same prompt-augmentation strategy is applied across the compared fine-tuning configurations. For example, a T6 template replaces Recommend with Recomend while keeping the history, requested list length, and output requirements unchanged.
blocks.zh: 为减少对单一即时措辞的依赖,建议实例采用表1所示的37个精密等效指示模板,分为6个家庭。 模板在措辞上不同,在任务语义上不同,包括直接建议、明确的规则清单、偏好框架、产出格式强调、压缩词句和小错拼。 在比较的微调配置中采用了同样的快速增强战略。 例如,一个T6模板在保留历史、要求的列表长度和产出要求不变的同时,用建议取代建议。

blocks.en: Table 1. Prompt template families used during fine-tuning. Shares give the proportion of recommendation examples assigned to each family.
blocks.zh: 图表 1. 微调时使用的快速模板家族。 份额给出了分配给每个家庭的建议实例的比例。

blocks.en: For the demographic-balancing conditions used in RQ3, we modify only the recommendation fine-tuning examples. The recommendation corpus size is held fixed at 99,900 examples, and the two groups of the balanced attribute receive 49,950 examples each. Under gender balancing, 3,620 male users contribute 13.8 examples each on average and 1,375 female users contribute 36.3. Under age balancing, using the binary split at 35, 2,152 older users contribute 23.2 examples each and 2,843 younger users contribute 17.6. Demographic labels are used only for constructing these balanced corpora and are not included in the recommendation prompts.
blocks.zh: 关于RQ3中使用的人口平衡条件,我们只修改建议中微调实例。 建议体积固定为99,900例,均衡属性的两组各收到49,950例。 在性别均衡方面,平均有3 620名男性用户提供13.8个实例,1 375名女性用户提供36.3个实例。 年龄不足的平衡,使用35,2,152个二进制分法,老年用户各提供23.2个实例,2,843个年轻用户提供17.6个实例。 人口标签仅用于构建这些平衡的蝎子,不列入建议提示。

blocks.en: For the knowledge-enriched condition used in RQ4, we add 7,683 auxiliary item-level question–answer examples about catalog movies. These examples cover genre and plot-style knowledge: genres are taken from MovieLens metadata, and plot summaries are taken from TMDB and joined to the catalog by item identifier. Answers that name a movie use the same <SOI> and <EOI> item-span markers as the recommendation task. The knowledge examples are added to the fine-tuning corpus rather than replacing recommendation examples, resulting in 126,739 total fine-tuning examples.
blocks.zh: 对于RQ4中使用的知识丰富条件,我们添加了7,683个关于目录电影的辅助项目级问答例。 这些例子涵盖了流派和图案风格的知识:流派取自MovieLens元数据,图案摘要取自TMDB,按项目标识符加入目录. 命名电影的答案使用与建议任务相同的“SOI”和“EOI”项目宽度标记。 将知识实例添加到微调程序中,而不是取代建议实例,结果总共产生了126,739个微调实例。

blocks.en: 4.2. Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2. 实施细节

blocks.en: All configurations fine-tune Llama-3-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) . The base weights are loaded in 4-bit NF4 with double quantization and a bfloat16 compute type, and low-rank adapters are trained on top, following QLoRA ( Dettmers et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2022 ) . LoRA adapters are applied to the attention query, key, value, and output projections and to the feed-forward gate, up, and down projections. We use rank r = 16 r=16 , scaling factor α = 32 \alpha=32 , and dropout 0.05. Because <SOI> and <EOI> are added as new tokenizer entries, the input embedding matrix and output language-model head are trained alongside the adapters.
blocks.zh: 所有配置都微调Llama-3-8B-Instruct(Grattafiori等人,2024年). 基重以4位NF4加载,双量子化和bfloat16计算型号,低级适配器在顶部训练,跟随QLORA(Dettmers等人,2023年;Hu等人,2022年). LORA适配器应用于注意力查询、密钥、值和产出预测以及上下投影的进气门。 我们使用排名 r = 16 r = 16, 缩放系数 α = 32\ alpha = 32, 和辍学 0.05。 由于添加了<SOI>和<EOI>作为新的表示器条目,输入嵌入矩阵和输出语言模型头与适配器一起接受培训。

blocks.en: Optimization uses paged 8-bit AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , a cosine schedule, and a warmup ratio of 0.03. Weight decay is set to zero and gradients are clipped at a norm of 1.0. Attention is computed with FlashAttention-2, and training uses a device batch of one sequence and gradient accumulation over 16 steps, giving an effective batch size of 16. Training performs a single pass over the fine-tuning corpus, so each example is seen exactly once.
blocks.zh: 优化使用页8位的AdamW,学习率为10−4 10^{-4},余弦表,热身比为0.03. 重量衰减被设定为零,梯度被剪切为1.0的规范. 注意用FlashAttention-2计算,训练使用一个序列和梯度累积在16个步骤以上的设备批次,有效批次尺寸为16个。 训练是一次通过微调程序,所以每个例子都只看到一次。

blocks.en:
At inference time, models are served with vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) . All headline evaluations use greedy decoding at temperature zero, a context window of 1,024 tokens, and a generation budget of 512 new tokens. Item spans are decoded with the prefix-tree constraint unless an unconstrained ablation is explicitly reported. Each test user is evaluated with the same ten-item history and a request for ten recommendations.
Each configuration is based on a single fine-tuning run with fixed data-generation and training seeds and is evaluated deterministically using a fixed checkpoint and prompt set.
blocks.zh:
推论时,模型使用vLLM(Kwon等人,2023年). 所有头条评价都使用在零温下贪婪的解码,上下文窗口为1,024个令牌,一代预算为512个新令牌. 物品跨度与前缀树约束解码,除非明确报告不受约束的剪切。 每个测试用户都接受同样的十项历史的评价,并请求提出十项建议。
每种配置都采用单一的精细调整,采用固定数据生成和培训种子,并使用固定检查站和即时集进行确定性评价。

blocks.en: 4.3. Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.3. 评价计量

blocks.en: We report metrics covering five complementary dimensions: recommendation utility, catalog usage, output control, prompt consistency, and demographic sensitivity. Recommendation utility is measured with Hit Ratio@10 (HR@10), which indicates whether the held-out test item appears among the ten generated recommendations. Catalog usage is summarized with Coverage@10 and Unique Items. Coverage@10 is the proportion of catalog items that appear at least once across all generated top-10 lists, while Unique Items reports the corresponding count of distinct recommended catalog items.
blocks.zh: 我们报告涉及五个相辅相成的方面:建议效用、目录使用、产出控制、迅速一致性和人口敏感性。 建议书的效用用点击率@10(HR@10)来衡量,这表明被搁置的测试项目是否在产生的10项建议中出现。 目录使用量以覆盖@10和唯一项目汇总。 覆盖度@ 10 是所有生成的十大列表中至少出现一次的目录项的比例,而独家条目则报告相应的不同推荐目录项数.

blocks.en: Output control is evaluated with Exact-10, Out of Domain@10 (OOD@10), and Repeat@10. Exact-10 is the proportion of responses containing exactly ten extracted item spans. OOD@10 measures the proportion of generated recommendations that do not correspond to valid catalog items. Repeat@10 measures within-list duplication among the generated recommendations. Higher Exact-10 and lower OOD@10 and Repeat@10 indicate more reliable recommendation outputs.
blocks.zh: 输出控制用Exact-10,Out of Domain@10(OOD@10)和Reduction@10来评价. 准确的10是包含10个提取项目跨度的回复比例。 OOD@10衡量生成的建议中与有效目录项目不符的比例。 重复@10在清单内对所产生的建议进行重复。 更精确的10和较低的OOD@10和重复的10表示更可靠的推荐输出.

blocks.en: Prompt consistency is evaluated in RQ1 using a separate set of five evaluation prompt variants. The variants preserve the same user history, target list length, and output contract while changing the request wording through a clean reference, paraphrase, instruction-wording change, format edit, and compact prompt. Prompt HR Spread is the difference between the highest and lowest HR@10 across the five variants. Prompt Jaccard compares each non-reference variant with the clean reference prompt for the same users and averages the resulting top-10 set overlaps across users and variants.
blocks.zh: 快速一致性在RQ1中使用单独的一套五个评价即时变体进行评价. 变体保留了相同的用户历史,目标列表长度,以及输出合同,同时通过干净的参考,解码,指令字修改,格式编辑,以及紧凑的提示来修改请求措辞. 即时HR Splace是五种变体中最高和最低HR@10的区别. Expoint Jacard将每个非引用变量与同一用户的清洁引用提示比较,并平均得出了用户和变量之间上-10集的重叠.

blocks.en: Fairness-related behavior is evaluated through paired prompt comparisons. For each user, we compare recommendations generated from the same interaction history under a neutral prompt and a demographic-conditioned prompt. Neutral-conditioned Jaccard measures the overlap between these two top-10 recommendation sets; higher values indicate that adding a demographic descriptor changes the recommendation list less. Pair Jaccard, used in RQ3, directly compares recommendation sets generated for the same history under two demographic descriptor values, such as male versus female or age < 35 <35 versus age ≥ 35 \geq 35 .
blocks.zh: 公平相关的行为通过对等的即时比较来评价. 对于每个用户,我们在一个中立的、符合人口条件的提示下,对同一互动历史产生的建议进行比较。 具有中立条件的Jaccard衡量这两类前十项建议之间的重叠;较高的数值表明,增加人口描述符对建议清单的改动较少。 在RQ3中使用的Pair Jacard直接比较在两个人口描述值下为同一历史生成的建议集,如男性对女性或年龄 < 35 < 35 > 与年龄 < 35\ geq 35。

blocks.en: We also report Neutral Gap and Sensitive-to-Neutral Similarity Range (SNSR) ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) . Neutral Gap is the absolute difference in HR@10 between demographic groups under the neutral prompt, reported in percentage points. For a demographic attribute with groups 𝒢 a \mathcal{G}_{a} , let J ¯ g \overline{J}_{g} denote the average neutral-conditioned Jaccard similarity for users in group g g . SNSR is defined as SNSR = max g ∈ 𝒢 a ⁡ J ¯ g − min g ∈ 𝒢 a ⁡ J ¯ g . \mathrm{SNSR}=\max_{g\in\mathcal{G}_{a}}\overline{J}_{g}-\min_{g\in\mathcal{G}_{a}}\overline{J}_{g}. Lower SNSR indicates that the demographic descriptor affects the evaluated groups more uniformly. We interpret Neutral Gap, Neutral-conditioned Jaccard, Pair Jaccard, and SNSR as indicators of demographic sensitivity and group-level utility disparity, not as direct evidence of discrimination.
blocks.zh: 我们还报告中性差距和敏感与新罗相似范围(Zhang等人,2023年)。 中立 差距是指在中速率下,以百分点报告的人口群体在HR@10中的绝对差异。 对于带有 G a\ mathcal{G}_{a} 组的人口属性, 让 J' \ g\ overline{J}_{g} 表示 G 组中用户的平均中性条件的 Jacard 相似性 。 SNSR的定义是 SNSR = max g ∈ ∈ ⁡ ⁡ ⁡ ̄ ̄ ̄ ̄ ⁡ ⁡ ⁡ ⁡ ⁡ ⁡ \ mathrm{ SNSR}\ max\\ g\\\\ mathcal{ G}_{a\\ overline{ J}_{g} -\ min_{g\\\\\ mathcal{ G}_{a\\ overline{J}_{g} 。 下SNSR表示,人口描述对被评价群体的影响更加一致。 我们把中性差距、中性条件的Jacard、Pair Jacard和SNSR解释为人口敏感性和群体一级公用事业差异的指标,而不是歧视的直接证据。

blocks.en: 5. Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 5. 实验结果

blocks.en: We organize the experimental analysis around four research questions that examine the reliability of the recommendation pipeline and the effects of preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data. We first establish the controlled recommendation backbone and then evaluate item-title representation, demographic balancing, and additional item information.
blocks.zh: 我们围绕四个研究问题组织实验分析,研究建议的管道的可靠性以及预处理选择对微调数据的影响。 我们首先建立控制下的建议主干线,然后评价项目标题表述、人口平衡和补充项目信息。

blocks.en: 5.1. RQ1: Does the recommendation pipeline provide sufficient catalog validity, output control, and prompt consistency for controlled comparisons of preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data?
blocks.zh: 5.1. RQ1:建议程序是否提供了足够的目录有效性、产出控制以及快速一致性,用于对微调数据中的预处理选择进行有控制的比较?

blocks.en:
Generative recommenders can return lists of the wrong length, repeat items, or name items that are not in the catalog ( Munson et al., 2025 ; Liao et al., 2026 ) . RQ1 therefore examines whether the pipeline provides a sufficiently controlled basis for the later comparisons of preprocessing choices and demographic sensitivity. Recommendation utility is part of that basis. A model whose lists are only weakly tied to the input can appear insensitive to demographic descriptors simply because it recommends poorly, so stability under demographic prompting is informative only once the pipeline recovers held-out preferences at a reasonable rate.
We first evaluate a structured supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baseline under unconstrained decoding and then apply prefix-tree constrained decoding to the same SFT weights to isolate the effect of catalog grounding. We next introduce the catalog-constrained training configuration and finally add prompt augmentation while keeping the catalog-constrained generation mechanism fixed. Prompt consistency is evaluated separately using five evaluation prompt variants. Table 2 summarizes these configurations.
blocks.zh:
基因推荐人可以返回目录中不正确的长度,重复项目,或名称项目列表(Munson等人,2025年;廖等人,2026年). 因此,RQ1审查管道是否为以后对预处理选择和人口敏感性进行比较提供了充分控制的基础。 建议效用是这一基础的一部分。 名单仅与投入微弱挂钩的模型似乎对人口描述不敏感,只是因为其建议差,所以只有在管道以合理的速度恢复被搁置的偏好时,人口推动下的稳定才具有信息性。
我们首先在不受约束的解码下评价一个结构化的有监督的微调(SFT)基线,然后对相同的SFT重量使用前缀-树约束的解码,以隔离编目搁浅的效果. 我们接下来将引入目录限制的训练配置,最后增加即时增强,同时保持目录限制的生成机制固定. 利用五个评价即时变体分别评价迅速一致性。 表2概述了这些配置。

blocks.en: The SFT baseline learns the structured <SOI> – <EOI> output format, but SFT alone does not provide reliable list-level control. Although it achieves an HR@10 of 7.47%, only 0.06% of its outputs contain exactly ten recommendations, and 2.08% of its recommended items fall outside the catalog. This indicates that learning the serialization format alone does not prevent variable-length or out-of-catalog outputs.
blocks.zh: SFT基线学习结构化的"SOI"–"EOI"输出格式,但单靠SFT并不能提供可靠的列表级别控制. 尽管它实现了7.47%的人力资源@10,但其产出中只有0.06%包含10项建议,其建议项目中有2.08%不属于目录范围。 这表明仅学习序列化格式并不妨碍可变长度或目录外输出.

blocks.en: Applying the prefix tree to the same SFT weights (SFT constrained decoding) reduces OOD@10 from 2.08% to 0.00% while leaving HR@10 essentially unchanged (7.47% versus 7.43%). This comparison isolates the effect of catalog grounding and shows that constrained decoding can eliminate invalid catalog items without substantially changing recommendation utility. However, constrained decoding alone does not provide list-level control: Exact-10 remains near zero (0.02%), while Repeat@10 increases from 3.12% to 4.86%.
blocks.zh: 将前缀树用于相同的SFT重量(SFT受限解码),将OOD@10从2.08%降至0.00%,而HR@10则基本保持不变(7.47%对7.43%)。 这种比较隔离了编目定位的效果,并表明受约束的解码可以消除无效的编目项目,而不会实质性改变推荐用途. 然而,单是受约束的解码并不能提供列表级别控制:Exact-10仍然接近0(0.02%),而read@10则从3.12%增加到4.86%.

blocks.en: The catalog-constrained training configuration improves list-level consistency. Exact-10 increases to 100%, OOD@10 remains at 0.00%, and HR@10 improves to 9.89%. This configuration produces consistently sized recommendation lists while restricting generated item spans to catalog-valid paths, thereby providing a more controlled output space for subsequent comparisons. However, repeated-item behavior remains substantial, with Repeat@10 reaching 10.56%. Thus, catalog validity and exact-length compliance do not by themselves eliminate within-list redundancy.
blocks.zh: 受目录约束的训练配置提高了列表层次的一致性. 准确的说,10增加到100%,OOD@10仍然保持在0.0%,HR@10则提高到9.89%。 这种配置生成一致大小的建议列表,同时将生成的项目跨度限制在目录验证路径上,从而为后续比较提供了更受控制的输出空间. 然而,重复的项目行为仍然相当严重,重复@10达到10.56%. 因此,目录的有效性和准确的遵守本身并不能消除清单内的重复。

blocks.en:
The prompt-augmented model retains the same catalog-constrained decoding mechanism while exposing the model to multiple semantically equivalent recommendation instructions during fine-tuning. The resulting model preserves 100% Exact-10 compliance and zero out-of-catalog generation, while improving HR@10 from 9.89% to 10.67% and reducing Repeat@10 from 10.56% to 8.01%.
Prompt augmentation also reduces sensitivity to prompt formulation: Prompt HR Spread decreases from 2.18 to 0.26 percentage points, while Prompt Jaccard increases from 0.6799 to 0.7489. These results indicate that prompt-augmented fine-tuning improves recommendation utility and prompt-level consistency while preserving the structural control established by the catalog-constrained pipeline.
blocks.zh:
即时增强型号保留了相同的编目约束解码机制,同时在微调时使该型号暴露于多个成体等效的推荐指令. 由此产生的模式保留了100%的准确-10合规率和零出目录生成率,同时将HR@10从9.89%提高到10.67%,并将Reduction@10从10.56%减少到8.01%.
即时增强还降低了对即时制剂的敏感性: 迅速人力资源扩展从2.18个百分点降至0.26个百分点,而迅速雅克卡尔从0.6799增至0.7489。 这些结果表明,快速强化的微调提高了建议效用和及时一致性,同时保持了编目限制管道建立的结构控制。

blocks.en: Taken together, these results show that SFT learns the structured recommendation format but does not provide reliable list-level control. Prefix-tree constrained decoding eliminates out-of-catalog generation, while the catalog-constrained training configuration provides consistent list-level outputs. Prompt augmentation preserves this structural reliability while improving recommendation utility, reducing repeated-item behavior, and decreasing sensitivity to prompt formulation. We therefore use the catalog-constrained, prompt-augmented pipeline as the controlled backbone for the remaining preprocessing and demographic-sensitivity experiments.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,SFT学习了结构化的建议格式,但没有提供可靠的列表级别控制。 前缀树受限解码消除目录外生成,而目录受限训练配置提供一致的列表级输出. 即时增强能保持这种结构可靠性,同时提高建议效用,减少重复项目行为,降低对即时制剂的敏感性. 因此,我们利用受目录限制的、迅速加固的管道,作为剩余的预处理和人口敏感性试验的控制骨干。

blocks.en: Table 2. Pipeline reliability, recommendation quality, and prompt consistency. Arrows give the preferred direction.
blocks.zh: 图表 2. 管道可靠性、建议质量和迅速一致性。 箭头给出了首选方向.

blocks.en: 5.2. RQ2: How does item-title representation affect recommendation utility and catalog usage within the catalog-constrained recommendation pipeline?
blocks.zh: 5.2. RQ2:项目标题表述如何影响建议效用和目录在目录约束性建议编目中的使用?

blocks.en: RQ2 examines whether the textual representation of catalog items affects recommendation utility and catalog usage while the underlying item identities remain unchanged. The prompt-augmented configuration uses normalized titles, where articles stored at the end of MovieLens titles are moved to the beginning; for example, American President, The (1995) becomes The American President (1995) . The original-title condition preserves the MovieLens title format. Both conditions use the same underlying catalog and recommendation setting.
blocks.zh: RQ2研究了目录项目的文字表述是否影响建议效用和目录使用,而基本项目身份保持不变。 即时增强的配置使用规范化的标题,将存放在电影Lens标题结尾的文章移到开头;例如,美国总统The (1995)成为美国总统(1995). 原标题条件保留了MovieLens标题格式. 两种条件都使用相同的基本目录和建议设置。

blocks.en: Table 3 shows higher recommendation utility and broader catalog usage with the original MovieLens titles. HR@10 increases from 10.67% to 12.47%, while Coverage@10 rises from 41.36% to 47.88%. The number of unique recommended items also increases from 1,606 to 1,859. Repeat@10 changes only slightly, from 8.01% to 8.43%.
blocks.zh: 表3显示较高的建议效用和较广泛的目录使用率,并列出最初的电影标题。 人力资源@10从10.67%增至12.47%,而覆盖面@10则从41.36%增至47.88%。 建议的独特项目数量也从1 606个增加到1 859个。 重复@10仅略有变化,从8.01%变为8.43%.

blocks.en: One possible explanation for these differences is the token-prefix structure induced by the two title representations. Moving common articles to the beginning can cause more normalized titles to share high-frequency initial tokens, increasing prefix sharing at early levels of the catalog trie; The is a common example. In contrast, the original MovieLens representation distributes titles across a wider set of initial prefixes. This changes the distribution of early prefixes and, consequently, the branching structure of the catalog prefix tree used during constrained decoding. Prior work also reported that textual item representation, and the resulting trie structure, can affect constrained generation and recommendation performance ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Liao et al., 2026 ) . However, changing the title representation also changes the token sequences used during fine-tuning. Therefore, the observed differences cannot be attributed to the prefix-tree structure alone.
blocks.zh: 造成这些差异的一个可能解释是两个标题表述引起的符号前缀结构。 将常见文章移动到开头,可导致更常态化的标题共享高频初始令牌,在目录trie的早期增加前缀共享; The是常见的例子. 相比之下,最初的MovieLens代表作品将标题分配到更广泛的一组初始前缀中. 这改变了早期前缀的分布,并因此改变了受限解码时使用的目录前缀树的分支结构. 先前的工作还报告说,文本项的表述以及由此产生的三重结构可能影响有限的生成和推荐性能(Liu等人,2026年;Liao等人,2026年)。 然而,改变标题代表也改变了微调时使用的符号序列. 因此,观测到的差异不能仅仅归因于前缀树结构.

blocks.en: Table 3. Effect of item-title representation on recommendation utility and catalog usage. Arrows give the preferred direction.
blocks.zh: 图表 3. 项目标题表述对建议效用和目录使用的影响。 箭头给出了首选方向.

blocks.en: Overall, RQ2 shows that alternative title representations of the same catalog are not interchangeable. Even when the underlying item identities remain unchanged, token ordering affects recommendation utility, catalog coverage, and the range of items recommended. Therefore, title formatting should be treated as a preprocessing choice to report explicitly rather than an implementation detail.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,RQ2显示,同一目录的替代标题表述是不可互换的. 即使基本物项的身份保持不变,象征性订购也会影响建议的效用、目录的覆盖范围以及建议物项的范围。 因此,标题格式应作为明确报告而不是执行细节的预处理选择。

blocks.en: 5.3. RQ3: How does demographic balancing in fine-tuning data affect recommendation utility and sensitivity to demographic descriptors?
blocks.zh: 5.3. RQ3:在微调数据方面的人口平衡如何影响建议效用和对人口描述的敏感性?

blocks.en:
RQ3 examines how balancing the fine-tuning data with respect to gender or age affects recommendation utility and fairness-related behavior. Both balancing interventions are evaluated under the same original-title representation.
We report HR@10 to measure recommendation utility and Neutral Gap to measure the difference in HR@10 between demographic groups under the neutral prompt. Demographic sensitivity is evaluated from three complementary perspectives. Neutral-conditioned Jaccard measures the overlap between recommendations generated with the neutral prompt and the corresponding demographic-conditioned prompt. SNSR measures how much this neutral-to-conditioned similarity differs between the demographic groups. Pair Jaccard directly compares recommendations generated for the same interaction history under the two values of the evaluated demographic descriptor, such as male versus female or age < 35 <35 versus age ≥ 35 \geq 35 . Higher Jaccard values indicate greater recommendation stability under demographic prompting, while lower Neutral Gap and SNSR indicate smaller group-level utility differences and smaller differences in demographic sensitivity, respectively. Table 4 reports the results for both balancing interventions.
blocks.zh:
RQ3研究了在性别或年龄方面对数据进行微调对建议效用和公平行为的影响。 这两种平衡发言都在同一原标题下评价。
我们向HR@10报告,以衡量建议效用和中性差距,在中性提示下,衡量人口群体在HR@10中的差异。 从三个相辅相成的角度评价人口敏感性。 中立的Jaccard衡量与中立的即时产生的建议和相应的符合人口条件的即时产生的建议之间的重叠。 SNSR衡量各人口群体之间这种中立与有条件的相似性的不同程度。 Pair Jacard直接比较了在评价的人口描述值的两个数值下为同一互动历史产生的建议,如男性对女性或年龄 < 35 < 35 > 与年龄 < 35\ geq 35。 较高的Jaccard值表明,在人口提示下,建议稳定性较高,而较低的中性差距和SNSR则分别表明群体层面的效用差异较小和人口敏感性差异较小。 表4汇报了平衡措施的结果。

blocks.en: For gender, balancing decreases HR@10 from 12.47% to 11.32%. The Neutral Gap increases from 0.45 to 1.21 percentage points, indicating a larger difference in recommendation utility between the gender groups under the neutral prompt. Neutral-conditioned Jaccard decreases from 0.8312 to 0.8240, while SNSR increases from 0.0519 to 0.0636. Pair Jaccard also decreases, from 0.8110 to 0.7918. Across the reported metrics, gender-balanced fine-tuning therefore does not reduce the observed gender-related differences or sensitivity and is accompanied by lower overall recommendation utility.
blocks.zh: 就性别而言,平衡将人力资源@10从12.47%降至11.32%。 中性差距从0.45个百分点增加到1.21个百分点,表明两性群体在中性提示下的建议效用差别较大。 中性条件的Jacard从0.8312减少到0.8240,而SNSR则从0.0519增加到0.0636. Pair Jacard也从0.8110减少到0.7918。 因此,在报告的衡量尺度中,性别均衡的微调并不减少观察到的与性别有关的差异或敏感性,同时减少总体建议效用。

blocks.en: The age-balanced configuration shows a different pattern. HR@10 changes only slightly, from 12.47% to 12.39%. The Neutral Gap decreases from 0.69 to 0.38 percentage points, while Neutral-conditioned Jaccard increases from 0.8195 to 0.8305. Pair Jaccard also increases, from 0.8407 to 0.8471. These changes indicate a smaller neutral-prompt utility difference between the age groups and greater recommendation overlap under both neutral-to-conditioned and direct descriptor-pair comparisons. However, SNSR increases from 0.0017 to 0.0077, showing that the neutral-to-conditioned similarity becomes somewhat less uniform across the two age groups. Age balancing therefore improves several of the reported age-related indicators while not improving all sensitivity measures.
blocks.zh: 年龄平衡配置显示不同的模式. HR@10只略有变化,从12.47%变为12.39%。 中性差距从0.69个百分点降至0.38个百分点,而中性有条件的雅克卡尔则从0.8195增至0.8305. Pair Jacard也从0.8407增加到0.8471。 这些变化表明各年龄组之间的中性-瞬间效用差别较小,在中性-有条件和直接描述-页的比较下,建议重叠较大。 然而,SNSR从0.0017增加到0.0077,表明中立到有条件的相似性在两个年龄组中变得不太统一。 因此,年龄平衡改进了报告的一些与年龄有关的指标,同时没有改进所有敏感性措施。

blocks.en: Table 4. Effect of gender- and age-balanced fine-tuning on recommendation utility and demographic sensitivity under the original-title representation. Arrows give the preferred direction.
blocks.zh: 图表 4. 在原标题说明下对建议效用和人口敏感性进行性别和年龄平衡微调的影响。 箭头给出了首选方向.

blocks.en: Taken together, the results show that the effect of demographic balancing depends on the demographic attribute and the evaluation measure considered. Gender balancing reduces overall recommendation utility and does not improve any of the reported gender-related indicators. In contrast, age balancing largely preserves overall recommendation utility while reducing the neutral age-group utility gap and increasing both Neutral-conditioned and Pair Jaccard. At the same time, its higher SNSR shows that the improvement is not consistent across all sensitivity measures. These results indicate that demographic balancing should be evaluated separately for each demographic attribute rather than assumed to have a uniform effect on fairness-related recommendation behavior.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,结果显示,人口平衡的效果取决于所考虑的人口属性和评价措施。 性别均衡减少了建议的总体效用,没有改进所报告的任何与性别有关的指标。 与此相反,年龄平衡在很大程度上保留了整体建议效用,同时缩小了中性年龄组的效用差距,并增加了中性条件和Pair Jacard两种功能。 同时,其较高的SNSR显示,在所有敏感性措施方面,改进并不一致。 这些结果表明,人口平衡应当针对每个人口属性单独评价,而不是假定对与公平相关的建议行为具有统一的影响。

blocks.en: 5.4. RQ4: Can knowledge-enriched fine-tuning data reduce demographic sensitivity while preserving recommendation utility?
blocks.zh: 5.4. RQ4:知识丰富的微调数据能否在保留建议效用的同时降低人口敏感性?

blocks.en:
RQ4 examines how incorporating additional item information through auxiliary fine-tuning examples affects recommendation utility and demographic sensitivity. We evaluate knowledge enrichment using the same original-title backbone and the same core evaluation dimensions as in RQ3: HR@10, Neutral Gap, Neutral-conditioned Jaccard, and SNSR.
The knowledge-enriched condition adds auxiliary examples to the fine-tuning corpus rather than replacing recommendation examples; consequently, this condition also contains more fine-tuning examples than the corresponding baseline.
blocks.zh:
RQ4审查通过辅助微调实例纳入额外项目信息如何影响建议的效用和人口敏感性。 我们利用与RQ3相同的原标题主干线和核心评价层面来评价知识丰富:HR@10、中立差距、中立条件的Jaccard和SNSR。
知识丰富条件为微调程序增加了辅助实例,而不是取代建议实例;因此,这一条件中还包含比相应基线更多的微调实例。

blocks.en: Table 5 shows that knowledge enrichment does not substantially harm recommendation utility. Overall HR@10 decreases by only 0.23 percentage points, indicating that the main recommendation performance is largely preserved.
blocks.zh: 表5显示,知识的丰富不会对建议效用造成重大损害。 总体HR@10只减少0.23个百分点,表明主要建议执行情况基本上得到保留。

blocks.en:
Knowledge enrichment reduces the Neutral Gap for both gender and age, while Neutral-conditioned Jaccard remains nearly unchanged. Thus, the smaller utility gaps are not accompanied by greater similarity between neutral and attribute-conditioned recommendation lists. This suggests that knowledge enrichment improves group-level utility alignment while leaving neutral-to-conditioned list overlap largely stable.
However, the effect on SNSR differs across attributes. Gender SNSR decreases from 0.0519 to 0.0291, whereas age SNSR increases from 0.0017 to 0.0123. Although SNSR for the age attribute remains small, the opposite directions show that knowledge enrichment does not affect between-group differences in demographic sensitivity uniformly across attributes.
blocks.zh:
知识的丰富缩小了性别和年龄的中立差距,而中立条件的Jaccard则几乎保持不变。 因此,在公用事业差距较小的同时,中性建议清单和属性条件建议清单之间没有更大的相似性。 这表明知识的丰富可以改善集团层面的效用协调,同时让中立到有条件的清单重叠,基本稳定.
然而,对SNSR的影响因属性而异. 性别SNSR从0.0519降至0.0291,而年龄SNSR从0.007增至0.0123。 虽然关于年龄属性的SNSR仍然很小,但相反的方向表明,知识的丰富并不影响不同属性在人口敏感性上统一存在的群体间差异.

blocks.en: Table 5. Effect of knowledge enrichment on recommendation utility and demographic sensitivity. Arrows give the preferred direction.
blocks.zh: 图表 5. 丰富知识对建议效用和人口敏感性的影响。 箭头给出了首选方向.

blocks.en: Overall, knowledge enrichment in fine-tuning data largely preserves recommendation utility while reducing group-level utility gaps for both gender and age. Its effect on SNSR is attribute-dependent: it lowers gender-related sensitivity but raises the age-related value, which nevertheless remains small in absolute terms. As in RQ3, the fairness-related effect of this preprocessing choice should therefore be interpreted separately for each attribute rather than assumed to be uniform. These findings suggest that incorporating additional item information into fine-tuning data can serve as a complementary data-level mechanism for reducing some forms of demographic sensitivity, even without an explicit fairness-specific training objective.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,在微调数据方面丰富知识在很大程度上保持了建议效用,同时缩小了性别和年龄群体一级效用差距。 它对SNSR的影响取决于属性:它降低了与性别有关的敏感性,但提高了与年龄有关的价值,但绝对值仍然很小。 因此,与RQ3一样,这种预处理选择的公平性效应应针对每个属性分别解释,而不是假定是统一的。 这些调查结果表明,将额外项目信息纳入微调数据中,即使没有明确的公平培训目标,也可作为一种补充性的数据级机制,降低某些形式的人口敏感性。

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6个 结论

blocks.en:
In this study, we examined how preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data affect utility and fairness-related behavior in generative LLM-based recommendation. Catalog-constrained decoding removed out-of-catalog items, the catalog-constrained training configuration produced complete ten-item outputs, and prompt augmentation improved prompt consistency and utility. Item-title representation affected both utility and catalog coverage even though the underlying item identities remained unchanged.
The effects of demographic balancing and auxiliary item-knowledge enrichment were attribute-dependent. Age balancing reduced the age-related utility gap while largely preserving utility, whereas gender balancing reduced utility without improving the evaluated gender-related indicators. Knowledge enrichment preserved utility and reduced group-level gaps, but its effect on demographic sensitivity varied across attributes and measures. A preprocessing choice therefore cannot be judged on utility alone, nor on a single attribute. Future work should control the size of the knowledge-enriched corpus and extend the evaluation beyond one dataset and binary demographic groups.
blocks.zh:
在这项研究中,我们研究了微调数据中的预处理选择如何影响基于基因的LLM推荐中的效用和公平相关行为. 编目限制解码器被移除出目录的物品,编目限制的训练配置产生了完整的十项产出,而迅速增强则改善了迅速的一致性和效用。 项目标题说明既影响效用,也影响目录的涵盖范围,尽管基本项目身份保持不变。
人口平衡和辅助项目知识丰富的影响取决于属性。 年龄平衡缩小了与年龄有关的公用设施差距,同时在很大程度上保持了公用设施,而性别平衡却减少了公用设施,而没有改进经评价的与性别有关的指标。 知识的丰富保存了效用,减少了群体层面的差距,但知识对人口敏感性的影响因属性和措施而异。 因此,无法仅根据效用或单一属性来判断预处理选择。 今后的工作应控制知识丰富体的规模,并将评价范围扩大到一个数据集和二进制人口组之外。
